coolhunting.title: The Office
coolhunting.notes: Adds three Dispatch pieces (Stephen Lawrence Prize shortlist, Glasgow School of Art rebuild campaign, Rike Concert Hall demolition) and retires the Pritzker, Venice Biennale, Serpentine Pavilion and Salone dispatches (past their six-week window). Extends the Stirling Prize calendar entry to note the Stephen Lawrence Prize and Reinvention Award share the same ceremony.
